title: Choose the main execution architecture
work: Compare the newer Flowise all-in-one flow with the older n8n and gateway pipeline. Record one default for the MVP, the role of the alternative, and where future scheduling and storage will live.
test: A short decision names the default execution path and lists the exact services needed to run a campaign, assistant, report and risk request.
note: The repository contains two implementations. Do not assume the older n8n architecture remains the chosen runtime.

title: Record the current runtime and startup commands
work: Locate the installed Flowise runtime, model, ports, storage paths and startup commands. Record versions and non-secret configuration.
test: A teammate can identify the required processes from one environment note. Record health results with a timestamp; distinguish model availability from application availability.
note: Baseline: Ollama responded; Flowise timed out after 3 seconds; n8n and gateway ports refused connections. These are observations, not proof of a permanent fault.

title: Restore the selected local runtime
work: Start or repair only the services needed by the selected architecture and check Flowise-to-Ollama connectivity.
test: Health endpoints respond and one AI-disabled risk request completes through the selected entry point. Save a redacted response and timing.

title: Make the Flowise test harness portable
work: Remove hard-coded runtime and /tmp export assumptions from the sandbox test. Accept explicit runtime/export paths and document prerequisites.
test: The harness loads the committed export from the repository and either runs or fails with a precise missing-dependency message on a clean shell.
note: The currently hard-coded /usr/local/lib/node_modules/flowise runtime was not present during inspection. This harness was not run.

title: Create a small reusable fixture pack
work: Prepare synthetic Tunisian company fixtures: strong lead, thin profile, exact duplicate, ambiguous name, conflicting official ID, missing identifier, unavailable source, and unsupported extracted fact.
test: Each fixture has an expected status and evidence references. Tests require no paid service or live personal data.

title: Agree versioned application request and response contracts
work: Draft schemas for campaign, company, assistant, report, risk and typed errors; document ID fields, nulls, readiness flags and partial results. Review with the backend owner.
test: Valid examples pass schema checks; missing company ID, wrong field types and unknown operations produce explicit errors. The selected runtime has an adapter to the same application contract.

title: Verify campaign intake validation and limits
work: Exercise the selected entry point with valid and invalid campaign criteria, oversized requests, excessive candidate counts and unknown sources.
test: Valid input preserves the campaign ID. Invalid input fails before source calls. Configured query, candidate and enrichment limits are enforced.

title: Add asynchronous campaign job intake
work: Create a persisted queued job and return its ID before source collection starts. Expose a status lookup through the agreed API.
test: A deliberately slow collector does not delay the intake response until completion; polling shows persisted QUEUED, RUNNING and final states.
note: The all-in-one prototype is synchronous and does not currently provide durable business jobs.

title: Verify multilingual research planning
work: Check French, English and optional Arabic query generation, enabled-source filtering, duplicate removal and query caps.
test: A software/Tunis fixture produces relevant bounded queries. Disabled sources and repeated queries are absent; invalid model JSON produces the documented error or fallback.

title: Validate candidate relevance decisions
work: Evaluate or implement ACCEPT, REJECT and REVIEW decisions for Tunisian enterprises, people, foreign businesses and unrelated job advertisements.
test: The fixture pack produces an explicit reason for every decision; unclear identity is REVIEW and a job advertisement without an identifiable employer is not accepted as a company.

title: Verify live B2B.tn discovery
work: Run one bounded B2B.tn sector/location query. Check filtering, raw record envelopes, response limits and unavailable-source behavior.
test: Each returned candidate includes source URL, retrieval time and checksum. A simulated failure returns a typed partial/failure status rather than invented candidates.

title: Implement a configured web search source
work: Define one provider adapter with source configuration, result limits and a disabled mode; implement against fixtures before enabling a provider.
test: A configured fixture provider returns source envelopes. An unconfigured provider remains SKIPPED and never reports successful collection.
note: Provider selection/access is a dependency for live testing. Do not enable billing as part of this planning task.

title: Verify the optional Google Maps adapter
work: Test Maps request and response mapping using fixtures; document the separate live-access and paid-source opt-in prerequisites.
test: No Maps call occurs without both configuration and explicit paid-source permission. A fixture response maps name, location and source identity correctly.

title: Meet the three-source-type discovery criterion
work: Confirm the MVP source set and run one controlled campaign using three configured source types. If a provider is unavailable, record the unmet criterion for team decision.
test: Evidence records identify three distinct source types and per-source counts. Missing access remains visible; fixtures alone do not count as live source acceptance.

title: Verify provenance on collected records
work: Check source URL, timestamp, source record ID, raw checksum and collection status across all active adapters.
test: Every accepted fact resolves to a source record; tampered or missing evidence is rejected or routed to review and raw evidence is not silently overwritten.

title: Run existing candidate-normalization regression
work: Run the committed offline regression for strong duplicates, ambiguous same-name records and stable generated IDs.
test: `node scripts/test_candidate_normalizer.js` exits 0: three raw candidates become two companies; two ambiguous companies remain separate and require review; IDs are deterministic.
note: PASS on 2026-09-28. This verifies the cases in the existing n8n workflow test, not the whole live pipeline.

title: Run existing RNE-policy regression
work: Run the committed offline regression for unavailable official lookups, missing identifiers and required-before-ready behavior.
test: `node scripts/test_rne_validation.js` exits 0: REVIEW creates the expected review item and REQUIRED_BEFORE_READY blocks both unverified fixtures.
note: PASS on 2026-09-28. This is a policy test with synthetic responses, not a live official RNE validation.

title: Run existing lead-scoring regression
work: Run the committed offline scoring test for strong/thin profiles, nested sector evidence, RNE conflicts and deterministic output.
test: `node scripts/test_company_scoring.js` exits 0: category A/C and nested-sector cases pass; conflict becomes REVIEW and cannot receive offers; repeated output is identical.
note: PASS on 2026-09-28. Score weights still need business calibration.

title: Run existing offer-recommendation regression
work: Run the committed offline offer test for evidence-based recommendations, eligibility gates and unknown commercial details.
test: `node scripts/test_offer_recommender.js` exits 0: eligible evidence produces offers; blocked company receives none; commercial_details stays null.
note: PASS on 2026-09-28. Product pricing and official commercial eligibility are not validated by this test.

title: Cover conflicting IDs and placeholder contacts
work: Add missing cases for same-phone/different-official-ID records and repeated directory URLs or placeholder contacts.
test: Conflicting official IDs never merge automatically. Directory placeholders are excluded from canonical contact fields while original evidence is retained.

title: Persist ambiguous matches for human review
work: Convert unresolved identity matches into durable review items with both candidates, evidence and a reason.
test: The ambiguous 3S fixture creates one review item without merging; opening the item shows the competing records and evidence.

title: Verify website collection limits and unsafe URLs
work: Test allowed public pages, contact-page discovery, redirects, timeouts, page/size limits and private-network blocking.
test: A public fixture site is collected within limits; localhost/private IP and redirect-to-private cases are blocked. A page failure preserves successful page evidence.

title: Verify evidence-grounded fact extraction
work: Exercise deterministic contacts and optional model extraction with missing fields, unsupported facts and quoted evidence.
test: Accepted facts contain matching evidence; missing values stay null; an invented employee count is rejected; malformed output follows the documented fallback/error path.

title: Implement field precedence and visible conflicts
work: Apply field-specific source authority and recency rules. Preserve official identity, operating locations, source descriptions and conflicting values separately.
test: Recent company evidence may update a business contact but never silently overwrites a conflicting official identifier. The stale-profile fixture retains both sources.

title: Verify completeness and readiness indicators
work: Check profile completeness, evidence quality and scoring/offer readiness against complete, thin, conflicting and partially enriched profiles.
test: Indicators stay within documented bounds; partial source failures preserve valid facts; blocked official identity cannot become offer-ready.

title: Obtain official RNE integration details
work: Obtain authorized API documentation, response examples, lookup identifiers, access arrangements and the required validation policy from the responsible team member.
test: The team identifies an access owner and supplies documented request/response contracts. Credentials enter the approved secret store, never a task note.
note: Blocked on official provider documentation/access; availability has not been confirmed. Preparing this card does not send a request to anyone.

title: Validate official RNE mapping and live lookup
work: Map real provider fields and verify VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, UNAVAILABLE and missing-identifier behavior.
test: An authorized known-company lookup preserves source evidence; a deliberate conflicting fixture blocks readiness; NOT_FOUND is not described as proof of illegitimacy.

title: Obtain the official Orange product catalog
work: Obtain versioned product names, features, eligibility, prices where applicable and an update owner.
test: A dated catalog is available with a commercial owner and clear unknown fields. Until then, family recommendations continue to require commercial confirmation.
note: Blocked on official commercial material; the repository currently contains eight families and matching rules, not a full approved catalog.

title: Import and validate the official catalog
work: Define a versioned catalog import and map approved products/eligibility to recommendation outputs.
test: Unknown product IDs are rejected; recommendations reference catalog versions; absent prices remain null and an expired or incomplete entry is not presented as a confirmed offer.

title: Add scoring boundary and missing-data cases
work: Cover 49/50 and 74/75 category boundaries, missing evidence, conflicting identity and component sum behavior.
test: Scores remain between 0 and 100; categories match documented boundaries; REVIEW overrides a high score; repeated input remains deterministic.

title: Review scoring and offer relevance with sales
work: Prepare a small anonymized lead set with explanations and ask the sales team to label useful priorities and relevant offer families.
test: Record disagreements, agreed weights/rules and an acceptance threshold before tuning. Keep measured quality separate from fixture test success.

title: Verify the DME company assistant
work: Test visit preparation, score explanation, missing data and RNE-conflict restrictions using one supplied company at a time.
test: Answers reference only supplied company evidence and approved offers; review-blocked companies do not get a sale-ready next step; scores and records remain unchanged.

title: Verify visit-report cleaning and evidence
work: Test French raw notes with needs, objections, commitments, explicit offers and follow-up actions; include vague or contradictory notes.
test: Original report and checksum are preserved; every extracted item quotes original text; unmentioned products and invented commitments are absent.

title: Verify risk rules and credential redaction
work: Test a clean event, RNE conflict, unsafe URL, rejected model output, prompt injection and synthetic credential exposure.
test: Clean fixture is LOW/ALLOW; defined high-risk fixtures block and require review; synthetic secret values do not appear in returned risk output; AI cannot change rule results.

title: Verify AI output schemas and bounded repair
work: Exercise invalid JSON, extra fields, unsupported facts and one-repair limits for each language agent in the selected runtime.
test: Bad output is never silently accepted. At most one repair is attempted where supported; failure returns a typed error or a documented deterministic fallback.

title: Design and test model-outage recovery
work: Reproduce an unavailable/slow Ollama node. Implement the chosen recovery behavior and surface whether deterministic output or manual retry was used.
test: A model timeout produces a controlled result and a clear retry/fallback indication. The AI-disabled path remains usable and approved scores/offers are preserved.
note: Known gap: native Flowise LLM transport failures currently stop the node; the older gateway fallback does not automatically apply.

title: Run adversarial extraction and prompt tests
work: Use synthetic web-page instructions, hidden prompt text and adversarial visit notes to check trust boundaries across language tasks.
test: Source text cannot change the task, expose configured secrets, authorize an offer or overwrite official status; unsupported outputs are rejected with evidence.

title: Run one deterministic end-to-end campaign
work: Run the chosen execution path with one bounded campaign and AI disabled, then use its company in assistant/report/risk requests.
test: Save timestamped stage counts, score, offers and review flags; all eight campaign stages are accounted for. Partial or unavailable official validation is reported honestly.
note: Select the harness for the chosen architecture. Historical acceptance-results.json is not a fresh pass.

title: Run the AI-enabled end-to-end acceptance path
work: Repeat representative campaign, extraction and language tasks with the native model enabled and record accepted/fallback outputs and latency.
test: Execution traces prove model nodes ran; AI cannot change official status, deterministic score or approved offer IDs; unavailable-model behavior matches the chosen recovery policy.

title: Agree the persistent business data model
work: Define tables and keys for campaigns, jobs, companies, evidence, reviews, scores, offer snapshots and visit reports with versioned migrations.
test: A schema review demonstrates one company linked to multiple evidence records, immutable report input and a durable job/review history.
note: Shared integration work. No application business database is supplied by the all-in-one prototype.

title: Persist validated company and evidence outputs
work: Add a validated write boundary with transactional upserts for company and source records and preserve conflict records.
test: A valid fixture persists and reloads with evidence references intact; an invalid fact cannot enter canonical fields; failed writes roll back cleanly.

title: Verify replay and concurrent-write idempotency
work: Replay a campaign/source payload and submit duplicate work concurrently using stable keys.
test: Company/evidence row counts do not double; duplicate jobs have one effective outcome; distinct source evidence for the same company remains preserved.

title: Implement reviewed conflict resolution
work: Expose review list/detail and an explicit reviewer decision with reason, actor and timestamp; recalculate readiness only after validated resolution.
test: An authorized reviewer can resolve a fixture conflict; unauthorized requests fail; audit history retains both the previous values and decision.

title: Define and enforce application role access
work: Confirm admin, DME and reviewer permissions with the team and enforce them at the API boundary, including access to reports and contact information.
test: An access matrix is agreed; unauthenticated and unauthorized requests fail; an agent cannot retrieve another agent’s restricted records by changing an ID.
note: Proposed shared application scope and owners, to confirm with the team; this is not an assignment made on their behalf.

title: Connect the admin campaign form and status view
work: Wire sector/location/source/limit controls to job intake and display persisted progress, partial results and errors.
test: Submitting a valid campaign returns a job ID and status updates; invalid input is explained; refresh retains the job; duplicate clicks do not duplicate work.
note: Proposed shared UI task; implementation is not present in this repository.

title: Build the company profile evidence view
work: Display company details, evidence links, score components, offer families, missing data and review restrictions from the validated API.
test: A thin-profile fixture shows unknowns explicitly; a conflict remains visible; every displayed fact can open its evidence and unsafe HTML is not rendered.
note: Proposed shared UI task; confirm with the application team.

title: Connect DME visit preparation to the assistant
work: Send a selected company and question to the assistant and show grounded advice, missing information and retry/fallback state.
test: Switching company updates the request context; blocked companies show review restrictions; connection failure is actionable and does not show stale advice.
note: Proposed shared UI task; the target web/mobile surface needs team confirmation.

title: Connect editable report review and saving
work: Show original notes beside structured output, allow a user to review corrections and save the approved report with evidence and revision history.
test: Raw notes survive unchanged; generated commitments are editable before saving; repeated save does not duplicate the visit report.
note: Proposed shared application slice; confirm report approval behavior with DME users.

title: Build the human-review queue screen
work: Display unresolved identity/legal conflicts with evidence, action choices and a decision reason.
test: A reviewer resolves a fixture item and sees the resulting readiness; a non-reviewer cannot resolve it; previous decisions remain visible.
note: Proposed shared UI task.

title: Confirm and implement manual prospect assignment
work: Confirm whether manual assignment is part of this release; if accepted, implement one authorized assign/reassign action and history.
test: Record an explicit scope decision. If included, authorized manual assignment changes the responsible agent with an audit entry; the AI never assigns automatically.
note: Tentative wider-platform feature. Split further after the team confirms its exact scope.

title: Confirm visit tracking and follow-up scope
work: Confirm visit statuses, dates and follow-up needs with DME users; choose one minimal visit lifecycle for the release.
test: Record the agreed scope. If included, a user can create a visit, attach approved notes and set a follow-up date without automatically contacting the company.
note: Tentative wider-platform feature; split into implementation cards once the workflow is confirmed.

title: Add correlated execution and audit logs
work: Attach campaign/company/job IDs and workflow/prompt versions to stage events, with durations and typed failure categories.
test: A fixture failure can be traced from intake to source/model/validation using one job ID; logs omit credential values and unnecessary report text.

title: Measure pipeline quality and latency
work: Record per-source success, accepted/rejected/merged/review counts, completeness, invalid-AI rate and time per accepted company.
test: A small fixed campaign produces a reproducible metric report with clear denominators; missing model token data is marked unavailable.

title: Set secret handling and trace retention rules
work: Check exports and synthetic execution traces for secret leakage; agree retention/access for source data, reports and Flowise traces.
test: Synthetic secret values are absent from exports and application logs; retained traces have documented access and deletion behavior. Never paste real secrets in evidence.

title: Implement bounded retries and job cancellation
work: Retry transient source failures with limits, retain successful source evidence, expose exhausted retries and honor cancellation at stage boundaries.
test: Timeout then success retries only the failed source; a permanent error stops after its limit; cancelling prevents new stage work and leaves a persisted terminal status.

title: Add scheduled discovery after manual jobs work
work: If recurring discovery is in the release scope, connect one scheduler to the same job intake and idempotency contract.
test: Two overlapping triggers do not create duplicate effective work; disabling the schedule prevents new jobs while preserving history.
note: Planned product capability only. No actual recurring automation is created by this board.

title: Package a reproducible staging deployment
work: Document pinned runtime versions, non-secret configuration, model prerequisites, migration/startup steps and health probes for the selected architecture.
test: A clean staging environment starts using the runbook and completes a deterministic smoke request; missing credentials are explicit and no real paid source is silently enabled.

title: Verify backup restore and rollback
work: Back up business data and flow/config versions, then restore a fixture dataset in an isolated environment; document rollback steps.
test: Restored company/evidence/report counts and links match; a previous flow version can be restored without overwriting newer unrelated data.

title: Run a bounded DME pilot acceptance session
work: Walk through campaign submission, lead review, visit preparation, report saving and conflict review on an agreed small dataset.
test: Capture observed results against MVP criteria, user feedback and unresolved limitations. Any unmet source/access/catalog criterion stays open or gets an explicit scope decision.

title: Prepare the demonstration and handover guide
work: Prepare the final architecture diagram, setup/run guide, demo script, endpoint examples, test evidence and known limitations.
test: A teammate follows the guide to run the selected demo and locate test results without undocumented steps. Claims of completion match current evidence.
